impact_assessment.why: A cadet earns a skill point before graduating but cannot see SKILLS
impact_assessment.benefits: Skill points are never missed; the rest stays hidden
impact_assessment.risks: contract: tab guards read the new data attribute; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: derived from mastery, none persisted

impact_assessment.why: Waiting out sublight transit tick by tick feels broken to beginners
impact_assessment.benefits: One click to arrive, never skipping an emergency
